subtasks.description: Explore codebase structure and identify files related to circuit representation, components, nodes, and existing analysis tools
Understand existing circuit data structures and how components/nodes are represented
Define data structures for isolated subcircuit detection results
Implement graph connectivity analysis using connected components algorithm
Implement ground path finding to identify nodes reachable from ground
Implement floating subcircuit detection (sections with no ground connection)
Add visualization support for isolated subcircuit sections
Add suggestion generation for connection points to integrate isolated sections

deferred_work: Implementation subtasks 3-8 depend on completing exploration subtasks 1-2 to understand the codebase structure and existing data models. Once the codebase is analyzed, the implementation tasks can be executed in order.
